titel: Mexican bake with nachos and cheese
stappen: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Chop the vegetables.
Brown the mince in the oil. Add the onion and garlic and fry for 2 min.
Add the sweet potato, pepper and courgette and fry for 3 min.
For sauce A: first stir in the spices (1 min), then add the passata, tomato purée and water. For sauce B: add the salsa with a splash of water.
Cover and simmer for 12 min until the sweet potato is almost tender.
Stir in the sweetcorn and beans and heat for 2 min. Season with salt and pepper.
Spoon everything into an ovenproof dish, scatter the nachos over the top and sprinkle with the cheese.
Bake for 10–12 min until the cheese has melted. Leave to rest for 3 min and serve with sour cream and coriander.
tips: Choose sauce A or B, not both.
Vegetarian: replace the mince with extra beans and sweetcorn. Spicier: add jalapeños or chipotle.
Make sure the nachos do not burn.
